standalone.quantities: DT/PR window ratio; >1 means PR faster

repeat_acceptance.acceptance: Original frozen exact-repeat prices. Each SKU needs >=10 different independent complete shapes over its full exact-repeat cohort. Each measured physical group must satisfy WAPE<=20% and max<=40%. Multiple channel fragments qualify only for row-aggregate total latency.

history_bounds.domain: Confirmed identical chip, shape, dtype, attributes, released kernel and input protocol within each group. Each lower bound is in-sample, not a latency forecast.

cache_subset.role: Censored lower bound. Original full-window job failed; no independent latency or all-core read-window verdict.
cache_subset.relation: Adding omitted reads cannot reduce interval demand. All included lanes passed endpoint checks.
